security_audit.summary: The skill repeatedly recommends downloading and piping an external installer into sh, creating a critical supply-chain execution risk. Its manual installation builds a download URL from a remote manifest, while local files and social actions can leave the user's environment. Most remaining detections are Markdown formatting, placeholder credential documentation, standard user directories, or expected first-party links.

remediation.issue: Remote installer content is piped directly into sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace every pipe-to-shell instruction with a version-pinned download, checksum and signature verification, user inspection, then explicit execution.

remediation.issue: The manual installer derives an artifact URL through shell substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Use a structured manifest parser, validate the scheme and host, quote the resolved URL, and pin the artifact version before downloading.

remediation.issue: Local file paths are automatically uploaded to a hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before each upload, display the resolved path and destination, and reject sensitive or unexpected paths by default.

remediation.issue: Social media commands can create immediate public or account-level side effects.
remediation.suggestion: Require a final confirmation that shows the account, action, content, and attached files before posting or changing account state.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends an unpinned npx package installation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the package version or immutable source revision and require user approval before installing the related skill.

content.user_title: Run Hosted AI Apps from Your Agent
content.value_statement: Managing hosted AI models often requires different APIs and workflows. This skill uses the inference.sh belt CLI to discover, run, and track cloud AI apps.
actual_capabilities: Lists and searches inference.sh apps by query, category, featured status, or publication date.
Retrieves app details and generates sample inputs before execution.
Runs hosted image, video, audio, language, search, 3D, and social apps.
Submits long-running tasks without waiting and retrieves their status or results later.
Uploads local files when an app input accepts a URL and receives hosted output links.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, network access, and available service credits.
App availability, model behavior, pricing, and output quality are controlled by external providers.
Local file inputs are uploaded to the hosted service and require sensitivity review.
The skill does not validate third-party app safety, generated facts, or social content.

use_cases.title: Create Media Prototypes
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, speech, or 3D assets from prompts and inspect the returned hosted results.

use_cases.title: Compare Hosted Models
use_cases.description: Search available apps, inspect input schemas, and run selected language or media models with controlled inputs.

use_cases.title: Automate Long Tasks
use_cases.description: Submit time-consuming generation jobs, record task identifiers, and retrieve outputs after processing completes.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Search inference.sh for apps that handle [task]. Show the best matches, categories, and required inputs. Do not run anything.

prompt_templates.title: Run One App
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [app name], generate a sample input, replace it with my requirements, and show the final input before running the app.

prompt_templates.title: Manage an Async Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Run [app name] without waiting using [input]. Record the task identifier, check status, and save the completed result to [destination].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Reviewed Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow using inference.sh apps for [goal]. Inspect every schema, pin versions, confirm uploads and external actions, then execute approved steps.

output_examples.input: Find a fast image model for a landscape concept.
output_examples.output: Recommended FLUX options with speed and quality notes, followed by the required prompt and image-size fields.

output_examples.input: Create a short video and return immediately.
output_examples.output: The selected video app, submitted task identifier, current processing status, and the command needed to retrieve the result.

output_examples.input: Use my local portrait for an avatar video.
output_examples.output: A review notice naming the local image and audio files, their hosted destination, and the final input awaiting upload confirmation.

best_practices: Inspect each app schema and generate sample input before submitting custom values.
Pin app and installer versions when reproducible behavior matters.
Confirm local uploads, social actions, costs, and other external side effects before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installer output directly into a shell.
Do not pass secrets or unrelated local files as app inputs.
Do not publish posts, messages, or account changes without final user approval.

faq.question: What is required to use this skill?
faq.answer: You need the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, network access, and sufficient credits for the selected apps.

faq.question: Which AI tasks are supported?
faq.answer: The documented catalog includes image, video, audio, language, search, 3D, utility, and X automation apps.

faq.question: Can it use local files?
faq.answer: Yes. Supported local paths are automatically uploaded when an app input accepts a URL.

faq.question: Can it track long-running jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can submit without waiting, retain the task identifier, and retrieve status or results later.

faq.question: Does it verify generated output?
faq.answer: No. Review factual claims, media quality, licensing, and policy compliance before using any output.

faq.question: Can it post to social media?
faq.answer: Yes. Some hosted X apps can post or change account state, so require explicit approval before execution.
